Product design concept render of 'Bluena', a handheld companion device: a large glossy white egg-shaped object about the size of a hand, smooth ceramic-like surface. On the front of the egg, a round touchscreen display (circular, slightly recessed, glowing softly with a tiny cute UI showing a small moon and orbiting planets). At the narrow top tip of the egg, a small round projector lens (glass, dark with a subtle blue reflection) for projecting a square screen. No text, no letters, no logos, no watermark. Clean studio product photo, three-quarter front view, soft white background, gentle shadow, premium minimal industrial design like a modern Japanese gadget, photorealistic.
